reply_text:
I told Marcus in #north-team that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is **10 June**, not 25 November.

- **Correction:** on 14 Oct, Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team, then corrected it the same morning in #north-random to 10 June, saying she'd read the wrong line. Marcus is in #north-random, so he can see the correction himself.
- **Year:** she didn't give one. I told Marcus it should be 10 June 2027, since it's the next renewal after October, but that Ilse hasn't confirmed the year.
- **Brain record:** it now holds only the 10 June date, sourced to Ilse's #north-random correction. The earlier 25 November entry no longer shows up.

My earlier reply in #north-random says I'd removed the date from the #north-team post, but that's not true. Both Ilse's message and my reply in its thread still show 25 November. To limit the confusion, my answer to Marcus tells people to ignore the 25 November in my earlier #north-team reply. I can't edit or delete Ilse's own message; if it should come down, she'll need to do that herself.
